title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the attenuation distance as delta = sqrt(2/(omega * mu * sigma)).

title: Understanding of Concepts
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of the relationship between conductivity, permeability, and frequency in the context of wave propagation in conductors.

title: Wave Equation Application
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the wave equation for a conducting medium and identify the relevant parameters.

title: Sign and Factor Checks
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as incorrect signs or missing factors in the final expression for attenuation distance.

title: Derivation Steps
description: Optional Criteria: The student may include intermediate steps in deriving the relationship between alpha and the parameters involved.

title: Physical Interpretation
description: Optional Criteria: The student could provide a brief explanation of what the attenuation distance represents in physical terms.
